asset_type: Image-generated whole-raster walk and waybill-tablet poses
provenance: Original built-in imagegen PNGs are preserved. Derivatives use alpha masking/cropping, 2D rigid raster-part transforms, common nearest-neighbor sampling, shared96 palette and bounded stance-only shader sampling. No code-painted character art, SVG or3D.
animation_status: Two original imagegen full-character sources are segmented into fixed torso/limb raster cutouts. Each gait has32 distinct assembled raster samples, not32 new imagegen drawings. Run has separate forward-leaning torso, stronger leg recovery and25% airborne samples. Pure2D custom cutout animation, not Spine.
registration_policy: One common whole-body scale per source sheet; no face/head scaling and no gesture-width normalization. Pelvis-projected foot origin, measured boot baseline and per-frame hip anchor.

walk.raster_assembly: Original generated torso and limb cutouts; per-leg measured 2D joint rotations; one uniform final sample scale. No new painted pixels.

stance_contract.residual_compensation: Only raster pixels below the pelvis shift; semantic supporting sole cancels caller displacement between adjacent samples. Sprite position is never changed.
stance_contract.turn_behavior: Mirroring replants current support without retaining an old-world-space anchor. No direction-history spring or delayed correction.

tablet_status: Read waybill, tap loading confirmation, then look toward cargo. Tablet never moves the parcel. Legacy internal gesture keys are retained for controller compatibility.
walk_registration_policy: Exact generated raster parts, measured per-leg joints, stable undeformed head/torso, one uniform final scale and a shared floor. Distance-driven lower-body-only residual compensation locks supporting feet without moving actor nodes.
